title: Starling Cycles Bikes For Life: A Lifetime of Steel Bicycles
content:
One easy payment. Fifty years. Ten frames. Five places.

Ride Starling till your dying day (or your knees give in).

For a single, simple, great-value one-off investment, customers will receive a brand new Starling Cycles frame every five years for the rest of their life, till their dying day, of up to 10 frames. That’s a staggering fifty years of frames offering a lifetime of beautifully simple, steel mountain bike frames.

Check out more at Starling Cycles.
